title: fluid-config console tokens
description: <dynamic_dir>/admin.json — tokens for the console and admin API. Never editable over the API. The FLUID_ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable (16+ characters) adds an editor token named env.

$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema for editor validation.

name.description: Shown in logs and the change history.

role.description: viewer: read everything, secrets masked. editor: also create and change APIs and records, revert changes, purge caches.
